short_description: The Anomaly (A.N.O.M.A.L.Y., Agency for Non-Ordinary Matter, Abnormalities and Liminal Yields)
description: The Anomaly is an interdimensional organization that locates, catalogues and contains anomalous creatures slipping through breaches between worlds.  Since the Cataclysm tore those breaches wide open, its specimens have started walking out on their own.
author: kaiZer9999
